description.text: Pocket Monsters Card Game Starter Pack, a product for the card game's 20th anniversary, released on 27 February 2016, twenty years to the day after Pokémon Red and Green. It recreates the game's very first product, the Starter Pack of 1996, down to the box design. Each holds a random 60-card deck of Kanto Pokémon, mostly reprints of XY and XY BREAK cards, with one of M Venusaur-EX or M Charizard-EX guaranteed, plus damage counters and markers, a plastic coin showing Chansey and a rule book. Sleeves with the original card back design came out the same day. A Blastoise version with Blastoise-EX and M Blastoise-EX, a deck alone, was sold first at the Blastoise Mega Battle tournament and from 17 June 2016 at Pokémon Centers.
